title: AI Cheating Parent Conference Kit
oneLiner: A teacher proof-and-conference room for AI-cheating cases where detectors are weak and parent pushback is inevitable.
theme: 사교육 / 역전 - academic integrity, parent conflict, AI shortcutting, and teacher reputation defense.
stitchPrompt: Build a production-grade school operations web app prototype called "AI Cheating Parent Conference Kit" for teachers handling suspected AI-written student work without overtrusting detectors. The first screen must be a working case room with a case confidence header, submission comparison lane, policy receipt drawer, parent pushback simulator, redo/consequence decision matrix, conference agenda builder, and department trend board. Use realistic sample data: a high-school essay, weak detector signal, missing draft history, syllabus AI clause, parent denial email, in-class explanation check, and a redo option. Design direction: use the operator-dense profile with compact charcoal/fog evidence tables, crisp status chips for known vs uncertain facts, and one sharp accent for conference deadlines. Do not make a marketing landing page; the first screen must be the working app.
